author: boma_naps
content:
Quick update on `debug_executionWitness` execution-apis #847 the specs-side questions are now resolved <@774033563732541451>  confirmed that sorting/deduplication is normative, and the 256-header cap is a protocol limit, Nethermind has also  adopted the same canonical witness model on the engine side (nethermind#12635).

Client teams that are not aligned with the spec yet should plan to align. If you’re opposed to any part of the design encoding, dropping mode, or key semantics please comment on the PR so we can resolve those points and pin down the final behavior   https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/847.  cc <@372731338031366165>
